title: Files & formats -- where it stands
thesis: A competent, safety-first formats module -- engine-backed file I/O, directories (with the Windows non-ASCII listing bug defeated), CSV, JSON, and a namespace-aware XML parser -- whose one genuine standout is XML security: XXE is closed by construction, the parser refusing <!DOCTYPE> and <!ENTITY> outright, which lxml and most XML libraries get wrong by default. Everything else is a deliberate subset: no XPath/XSLT/validation, a flat HTML index, zip-only archives via Haro's minizip, UTF-8 only, and whole-file reads with a 64 MB cap.

lanes.lane: XML security -- XXE closed by construction
lanes.note: xml.zig refuses any document containing <!DOCTYPE> or <!ENTITY>, a hard failure; guarded: a file:///etc/passwd entity doc returns FALSE, SAML docs parse.
read/write/append/copy/delete/stat engine-backed with a pathIsUsable screen; 64 MB read cap, no streaming, no mmap/seek, Move is copy+delete.
list/walk/create/delete/count via stz_dir_*; non-ASCII listing fixed with the wide-W API (guarded: Arabic/CJK/Hebrew/emoji names, listed count == engine count).
lanes.proof: stz_dir_*, stzFolder; non-ASCII guard under test/file

lanes.note: csv.zig RFC-4180 quoting, header auto-detect, exact round-trip inference; eval() on cells removed, byte-scan number test ~156x faster; no multiline fields.
json.zig parse/serialize/pretty; the UTF-8 trap fixed in StzJsonToList, but the stzJson class constructor still calls the old pure-Haro parser; no JSONPath.
Strict namespace-aware parser shared with xmldsig.zig/SAML, exclusive C14N, a small local-name path grammar; no XPath, XSLT or DTD/XSD validation.
fswatch.zig snapshots (mtime, size) and diffs to ADD/MOD/DEL; stzFolderWatcher Watch/Drain/Stop; polling-based, no native OS events.
html_dom.zig tokenizer + flat element index with tag/#id/.class selectors, double-decode fix, O(n^2) Find fix; no real DOM tree, no combinators, read-only.
stzZipFile read/write backed by Haro's native ziplib (minizip), not the engine; compressor.zig only crc32/adler32/RLE; zip only, no tar/gzip/7z.
Engine stz_path_extension/basename/dirname only (both / and \); no join, normalize, relative-to or glob, no path object.
Whole-file read only with a hard 64 MB cap; the one large-file path is JsonFilterFeatures (GeoJSON in-engine); no streaming, iterparse or mmap.
None for text: codec.zig is Base64 only, everything UTF-8 by design; no charset detection, no non-UTF-8 decoding (Windows-1252, Shift-JIS).

standouts: XXE closed by construction: the parser refuses <!DOCTYPE> and <!ENTITY>, a posture lxml defaults to wrong
The Windows non-ASCII directory listing bug defeated (wide-W API to UTF-8)
One strict namespace-aware XML parser shared with XML digital signatures (SAML), with exclusive C14N
CSV eval() on list-looking cells removed; byte-scan number test ~156x faster than regex-per-cell
gaps: Migrate the stzJson constructor to the fixed UTF-8 parser (shipped but unwired)
Streaming and large-file reads past the 64 MB cap; iterparse-style XML/JSON
A real archive layer (tar, gzip/zlib); charset detection and non-UTF-8 decoding
Multiline CSV, richer HTML (slice 3), XPath, a pathlib-style path surface
dated: Read from the source on 2026-09-16, from a read-only main worktree
